GripShift.name: GripShift
GripShift.summary: Speed your way through insane levels in this nitrous fueled, star collecting, driving action game!

Ikki Tousen - Xross Impact.name: Ikki Tousen: Xross Impact
Ikki Tousen - Xross Impact.summary:
Choose a pair of your favourite characters and take them on this 2D Belt scrolling action, let the girls cooperate with each other to launch combos, or switch them in and out to let the player character rest.

22 girls will join the battle with a complete new plot. Warriors who were out of the game are back with new skin tight dresses. Watch the fully voiced cut-ins when you launch sure kill attacks and see what damage you do to your opponents and their clothings. Beware, though, your opponents can do the same to you.

Madden NFL 09.name: Madden NFL 09
Madden NFL 09.summary: PlayStation Portable port of Madden NFL 09.

Petz - Hamsterz Bunch.name: Petz Hamsterz Bunch
Petz - Hamsterz Bunch.summary: Raise, care and play with a family of hamsters on the PSP! Adopt a hamster and customize your pet's look with tons of fun types and colors. Keep them occupied and watch them grow as you become the proud parent of hamsters.

Shin Megami Tensei - Persona 2 - Innocen.name: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 2 - Innocent Sin
Shin Megami Tensei - Persona 2 - Innocen.summary: Updated port of Persona 2: Innocent Sin for the PSP. Features a new quest, remixed music and updated artwork.

Super Fruit Fall.name: Super Fruit Fall
Super Fruit Fall.summary: The object of the game is to get rid of all the fruit by spinning the puzzle frame in order to combine matching fruit into formations or 3 or more before the time runs out.
